[P1] Keep the public inference entrypoint under `torch.no_grad()`. The decorator newly added to `self.model.forward` does not cover `self.logits_processor(...)`/LM head. Normal eager decode and non-CP extend call this outer method without an enclosing inference/no-grad context, so the LM head starts recording an autograd graph for each request (and retains its input hidden states). This is a substantial memory/performance regression.
its the common path for eagle decode and cp prefill

+                dtype=torch.int32,

+        forward_batch.dsv4_cp_metadata_prepared = True

+        forward_batch.dsv4_cp_local_positions = local_positions

+    @contextmanager

inline_comments.body: [P1] Keep the public inference entrypoint under `torch.no_grad()`. The decorator newly added to `self.model.forward` does not cover `self.logits_processor(...)`/LM head. Normal eager decode and non-CP extend call this outer method without an enclosing inference/no-grad context, so the LM head starts recording an autograd graph for each request (and retains its input hidden states). This is a substantial memory/performance regression.
its the common path for eagle decode and cp prefill
